title: Reuse validated explicit RelationSignature records instead of reconstructing them per inspected edge

masterplan.active_gate: Gate 1 — Renovation, owner-directed Genesis and general computer assistance

scope: Refactor only the explicit signatures= path of the existing compile_relation_blocks owner. Key the already validated requested RelationSignature records once by their canonical three-field tuple and reuse those records for matching Forest edges and verified bindings. Preserve discover-all construction, endpoint completeness, Fourfold relation-digest admission, cross-plane verified-binding admission and undirected fail-closed behavior. Do not add a cache, persistent index, second compiler, receipt family, backend or graph authority.

implementation.summary: Explicit plans now build one bounded requested_by_key mapping from canonical signature tuple to the already validated requested RelationSignature. Selected Forest edges and verified bindings retrieve that record rather than constructing an equivalent RelationSignature for each inspected row. Explicit undirected reverse-conflict detection uses the reverse tuple key without constructing a reverse RelationSignature. Discover-all behavior still constructs canonical RelationSignature records as before.

focused_contract.behavior: After constructing the requested code:imports:code RelationSignature, the test tracks RelationSignature.__init__ during explicit selected compilation. No new constructor call is permitted; the emitted block must retain object identity with the requested record and preserve the exact canonical Boolean entry while an unrelated retained relation is pruned.
